args.title: Notify report owner when scheduled exports fail
args.body:
File: src/export/scheduler.ts

Add logic to notify the report owner when a scheduled export fails. This will prevent situations where the report remains due without the owner's knowledge, as seen in the recurring failures of 'Vendor payments YTD'. Implement a notification mechanism within the `runScheduledExport` function to alert the owner about failed exports.
